reference_role: Atmosphere only: soft natural-light photographs behind layered white UI. New imagery generated without reference product UI or typography.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: understated photographic background behind layered white product UI on a quiet financial website.
Create a new landscape photograph in exact 4:3 aspect ratio, preferably 1536 by 1152 pixels. Photograph of a luminous soft blue sky with believable gently drifting clouds. Muted slate-to-pale blue across the upper portion, warm ivory and pale cream clouds in the lower half, softly lit by hazy late-afternoon daylight. Restrained low contrast, subtle natural photographic grain, atmospheric realism. The centre is softly open and visually quiet, enough softly lit empty area for white interface fragments to be placed over it later. Cropped sky only; no ground or scenery objects. Clouds should have real delicate vapor texture rather than graphic blobs. Contemporary understated editorial photography, soft focus atmospheric depth, no dramatic orange sunset.
Constraints: photograph only, no product UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no money, no cards, no buildings, no illustration, no artificial gradient, no graphic shapes. Fill the entire image edge to edge.
assets.inspection: Visually inspected: natural photographic landscape, restrained contrast, quiet central space, no UI, text, logos or watermarks. Original tool output copied unchanged.
